mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO draw_order (u_id, activity_id, order_id, take_id, award_fulfillment_status, award_id, award_type, award_name, award_content, fulfillment_event_status, stock_settlement_event_status, stock_retry_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{uId},#{activityId},#{orderId},#{takeId}, #{awardFulfillmentStatus},#{awardId},#{awardType}, #{awardName},#{awardContent},#{fulfillmentEventStatus},#{stockSettlementEventStatus},
CASE WHEN #{stockSettlementEventStatus}=0 THEN TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE,10,NOW(3)) ELSE NULL END, NOW(3), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE draw_order SET stock_settlement_event_status = 1, update_time = NOW(), stock_retry_at = NULL, stock_settled_at = NOW(3), fulfillment_retry_at = CASE WHEN COALESCE(award_fulfillment_status,0) != 1 THEN TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,5,NOW(3)) ELSE NULL END WHERE u_id = #{uId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND #{stockSettlementEventStatus}=1 AND stock_settlement_event_status=0
mapper.select: SELECT id, u_id, activity_id, order_id, take_id, fulfilled_at, award_fulfillment_status, award_id, award_type, award_name, award_content, fulfillment_event_status, stock_settlement_event_status, create_time, update_time FROM draw_order WHERE u_id = #{uId}

SELECT id, u_id, activity_id, order_id, take_id, fulfilled_at, award_fulfillment_status, award_id, award_type, award_name, award_content, fulfillment_event_status, stock_settlement_event_status, create_time, update_time FROM draw_order WHERE u_id = #{uId} AND order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, u_id, activity_id, order_id, take_id, fulfilled_at, award_fulfillment_status, award_id, award_type, award_name, award_content, fulfillment_event_status, stock_settlement_event_status, create_time, update_time FROM draw_order WHERE u_id = #{uId} AND take_id = #{takeId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT u_id, order_id, activity_id, take_id, award_id FROM draw_order WHERE stock_retry_at <= NOW(3) AND stock_settlement_event_status=0 ORDER BY stock_retry_at, order_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u_id, order_id, take_id, award_id, award_type, award_name, award_content FROM draw_order WHERE fulfillment_retry_at <= NOW(3) AND fulfillment_event_status=0 AND stock_settlement_event_status=1 AND COALESCE(award_fulfillment_status,0) != 1 ORDER BY fulfillment_retry_at, order_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE draw_order SET = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{leaseSeconds},NOW(3)) WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND AND <= NOW(3)
